request.query: Lower bound for finite sum positive parts of decreasing arithmetic progression by linear or quadratic bound; truncated triangular sum

items.name: Finset.le_sum_schlomilch
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {f : ℕ → M} {u : ℕ → ℕ},
  (∀ ⦃m n : ℕ⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < u n) →
      Monotone u →
        ∀ (n : ℕ),
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (u n), f k ≤
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (u 0), f k + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (u (k + 1) - u k) • f (u k)

items.name: Finset.le_sum_schlomilch'
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {f : ℕ → M} {u : ℕ → ℕ},
  (∀ ⦃m n : ℕ⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < u n) →
      Monotone u → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico (u 0) (u n), f k ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (u (k + 1) - u k) • f (u k)

items.name: AntitoneOn.sum_le_integral
items.type:
∀ {x₀ : ℝ} {a : ℕ} {f : ℝ → ℝ},
  AntitoneOn f (Set.Icc x₀ (x₀ + ↑a)) → ∑ i ∈ Finset.range a, f (x₀ + ↑(i + 1)) ≤ ∫ (x : ℝ) in x₀..x₀ + ↑a, f x

items.name: Finset.sum_schlomilch_le'
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {f : ℕ → M} {u : ℕ → ℕ},
  (∀ ⦃m n : ℕ⦄, 1 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < u n) →
      Monotone u →
        ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (u (k + 1) - u k) • f (u (k + 1)) ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico (u 0 + 1) (u n + 1), f k

items.name: Finset.sum_schlomilch_le
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {f : ℕ → M} {u : ℕ → ℕ}
  {C : ℕ},
  (∀ ⦃m n : ℕ⦄, 1 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < u n) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 ≤ f n) →
        Monotone u →
          SuccDiffBounded C u →
            ∀ (n : ℕ),
              ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (u (k + 1) - u k) • f (u k) ≤
                (u 1 - u 0) • f (u 0) + C • ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico (u 0 + 1) (u n + 1), f k

items.name: ENNReal.le_tsum_schlomilch
items.type:
∀ {u : ℕ → ℕ} {f : ℕ → ENNReal},
  (∀ ⦃m n : ℕ⦄, 0 < m → m ≤ n → f n ≤ f m) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < u n) →
      StrictMono u → ∑' (k : ℕ), f k ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (u 0), f k + ∑' (k : ℕ), (↑(u (k + 1)) - ↑(u k)) * f (u k)
